entries.jp: 京都の夕空に\n細長い煙が上ってゆく
entries.en:
A thin trail of
smoke rose into
the evening
sky over Kyoto.

entries.jp: 土方歳三と沖田総司は\n近藤勇の墓前に線香を立て\n静かに手を合わせていた
entries.en:
Toshizo Hijikata
and Soji Okita lit
incense at Isami
Kondo's grave
and quietly
pressed their
hands together
in prayer.

entries.jp: お久しぶりです\n近藤さん
entries.en: It's been a while,\nKondo-san.

entries.jp: 近藤さんに代わって\n新選組の局長になって\nずいぶん経ちますが――
entries.en:
It's been a long
time since I
took your place,
Kondo-san, as
Commander of
the
Shinsengumi--

entries.jp: 局長としての責務に\n忙殺されるばかりです
entries.en:
But the duties
of Commander
keep me
buried in work.

entries.jp: しばらく顔を出せなくて\nすみませんでした
entries.en: I'm sorry I haven't\ncome to see you\nin so long.

entries.jp: 近藤さん\nこの通りだ
entries.en: Kondo-san. I beg\nyour forgiveness.

entries.jp: 土方は両手を合わせると\n近藤の墓前に\n深く頭を下げた
entries.en:
Hijikata pressed
his palms
together and
bowed his head
deeply before
Kondo's grave.

entries.jp: 沖田は土方の横顔を\nただじっと\n見つめていた
entries.en: Okita simply\ngazed at\nHijikata's profile.

entries.jp:
いつものように軽口も
叩かず　土方が頭を上げる
までの間　一言も喋らない
まま　ただじっと
彼を見つめ続けていた
entries.en:
He made none of
his usual jokes;
he didn't say a
single word until
Hijikata raised his
head. He just kept
gazing at him.

entries.jp: 総司\nお前も挨拶しろ
entries.en: Soji. Pay your\nrespects too.

entries.jp: 言われなくても\n分かってますよ
entries.en: I know. You don't\nhave to tell me.

entries.jp: 土方に促されて\n沖田は近藤の墓前に\n軽く頭を下げた
entries.en:
Prompted by
Hijikata, Okita
gave a light
bow before
Kondo's grave.

entries.jp: どうも\n近藤さん
entries.en: Hey there,\nKondo-san.

entries.jp: 貴方は誰とでも上手く\nやれる人だったから
entries.en:
You were the
kind of person
who got along
with anybody,

entries.jp: きっとあっちへ行っても\n愉快にやってますよね
entries.en:
so I bet you're
having a
grand old time
over there too.

entries.jp: 僕らも　なんとか\n元気にやってます
entries.en: We're managing\nto get by all\nright, too.

entries.jp: 土方さんは――\nそうですね\n少々お疲れのようですけど
entries.en:
As for
Hijikata-san--
Let's see... he
seems a little
tired.

entries.jp: おい　総司\n出鱈目を言うな
entries.en: Hey, Soji. Don't\ntalk nonsense.

entries.jp: 俺は疲れてなどいない\nこの通り気力に\n満ち溢れている
entries.en:
I'm not tired
in the least. As
you can see,
I'm brimming
with vigor.

entries.jp: へぇ\nそうですか？
entries.en: Oh? Is that so?

entries.jp: お偉方との折衝に\n苦労してるみたい\nじゃないですか
entries.en:
Looks to me like
you've been
having a rough
time dealing
with the bigwigs.

entries.jp: 最近はお酒の量も\n増えてるみたいだし\n僕は心配だなあ
entries.en:
And you've
been drinking
more lately too.
I'm worried,
you know.
Mm...

entries.jp: 僕の目は\n誤魔化せませんよ
entries.en: You can't\nfool my eyes.

entries.jp: それに近藤さんの目の前で\n嘘はいけないと思います
entries.en:
Besides, I don't
think you should
lie right in front
of Kondo-san.

entries.jp: ふぅ……
entries.en: Sigh...

entries.jp: ああそうだ\n最近確かに疲れている\nだが仕方ないだろう
entries.en:
Yes, fine. I
have been tired
lately. But it
can't be helped.

entries.jp: 近藤さんがいなくなった\n穴は　簡単に塞がるような\n小さなものではない
entries.en:
The hole
Kondo-san left
behind isn't
something small
that's easily filled.

entries.jp: 血を吐くような思いで\n責務に臨んで　まだ\n足りないと思っている
entries.en:
I face my duties
feeling like I'm
coughing up
blood, and it's
still not enough.

entries.jp: それに酒だって\n近藤さんの十分の一も\n飲んでないだろう
entries.en:
And as for
drinking, I
don't drink a
tenth of what
Kondo-san did.

entries.jp: 近藤の墓前を見つめながら\n土方は嘘偽りのない心境を\n話した
entries.en:
Gazing at Kondo's
grave, Hijikata
spoke his true
feelings without
any pretense.

entries.jp:
すると　今まで顔を
見せていた夕陽が
大きな雲に隠れてしまい
突然辺りが暗くなった
entries.en:
Just then, the
evening sun that
had been shining
hid behind a
large cloud, and
everything
suddenly went
dark.

entries.jp: これは一体？
entries.en: What's this?

entries.jp: もしかしたら\n近藤さんが心配してるん\nじゃないですか？
entries.en: Maybe Kondo-san\nis worried about\nyou?

entries.jp: そんなバカなこと\nあるわけがないだろう
entries.en: Don't be\nridiculous.\nThat can't be.

entries.jp: そうですか？\n近藤さんなら\nあり得ると思いますね
entries.en: You think? With\nKondo-san, I'd\nsay it's possible.

entries.jp: 試してみましょうか
entries.en: Shall we test it?

entries.jp: 試すといっても\nどうするんだ？
entries.en: Test it how?

entries.jp: 近藤さんのアーホー！
entries.en: Kondo-san, you\nbig dummy!

entries.jp: 近藤さんの\nおたんちーん！
entries.en: Kondo-san, you\nnincompoooop!

entries.jp: こ　これは……？
entries.en: Wh-what is this...?

entries.jp: なんちゃって\n今のは全部ウソ！
entries.en: Just kidding!\nThat was all a lie!

entries.jp: 近藤さんになら\n抱かれてもいい！\nいやむしろ抱いてほしい！
entries.en:
I'd let Kondo-san
hold me anytime!
No, actually, I'd
love for him to!

entries.jp: お　おお……
entries.en: Wh-whoa...

entries.jp: ほらね\nやっぱり近藤さんが\n心配してるんですよ
entries.en: See? Kondo-san's\nworried after all.

entries.jp: 土方さんが血を吐くとか\n物騒なこと言ったから
entries.en:
Because you
said something
alarming like
coughing up
blood,
Hijikata-san.

entries.jp: あ　いや　近藤さん\n本当に血は吐いてない\n物の例えだ
entries.en:
Ah, no,
Kondo-san, I'm
not actually
coughing up
blood. It was a
figure of speech.

entries.jp: 土方が否定したものの\n再び雲行きは\n怪しくなってしまった
entries.en:
Though Hijikata
denied it, the
sky turned
threatening
once again.

entries.jp: あーあ\n今にも泣き出しそうな\n空模様ですね
entries.en: Uh-oh. Looks like\nthe sky's about to\nburst into tears.

entries.jp: なっ……
entries.en: Wha...

entries.jp: 土方は真っ青になり\n慌てて首を振った
entries.en: Hijikata went pale\nand hurriedly\nshook his head.

entries.jp: そんなに心配するな\n近藤さんっ
entries.en: Don't worry so\nmuch, Kondo-san!

entries.jp: 局長の仕事は\n慣れない事ばかりだが
entries.en:
The Commander's
work is still
unfamiliar to me,
but...

entries.jp: 俺の隣には貴方が\n引き合わせてくれた\n同志が……総司がいる
entries.en:
At my side is the
one you brought
to me, who shares
my cause... Soji.

entries.jp: 近藤さんも総司の優秀さは\n知っているだろう
entries.en: You know how\ncapable Soji is\ntoo, Kondo-san.

entries.jp: こいつと新選組の仲間が\nいればきっと大丈夫だ！\nだから安心してくれ
entries.en:
With him and our
Shinsengumi
comrades, we'll be
fine! So rest easy.

entries.jp: 近藤さん\n聞きました？
entries.en: Kondo-san, did\nyou hear that?

entries.jp: 土方さんはこんな感じで\n毎日必死にやってますよ
entries.en:
This is how
Hijikata-san goes
at it, desperately,
every single day.

entries.jp: まあ　部下としては\n正直ウザいと思う時も\nありますけど
entries.en:
Well, as his
subordinate,
honestly, there
are times I find
him a real pain.

entries.jp: えっ？\nお　おい　総司
entries.en: Huh? H-hey, Soji.

entries.jp: 土方さんが必死に\nやってるのは\nみんな分かってます
entries.en:
Everyone knows
how hard
Hijikata-san is
trying.

entries.jp: 土方さんの　新選組を\n大切に思う気持ちは\n近藤さんにも負けません
entries.en:
Hijikata-san
cares for the
Shinsengumi
every bit as
much as you
did, Kondo-san.

entries.jp: そ　そうだ\n総司の言う通りです\n近藤さん
entries.en: Y-yes. Soji's\nright, Kondo-san.

entries.jp: 気持ちだけはね
entries.en: In spirit, at least.

entries.jp: お　おう……
entries.en: R-right...

entries.jp: だからさ　近藤さん\n墓参りになかなか来られない\n土方さんを許してあげて
entries.en:
So, Kondo-san,
please forgive
Hijikata-san
for hardly
ever making it
to your grave.

entries.jp: 土方さんは近藤さんのこと\n忘れたわけじゃないんです
entries.en:
It's not that
Hijikata-san
has forgotten
you, Kondo-san.

entries.jp: 近藤さんが遺したものを\n守ろうと　馬鹿みたいに\n必死になってるだけです
entries.en:
He's just working
himself to the
bone like an idiot
to protect what
you left behind,
Kondo-san.

entries.jp: ……ちょっと待て\n総司
entries.en: ...Hold on, Soji.

entries.jp: は？\nなんですか？
entries.en: Huh? What is it?

entries.jp: お前は俺を貶してるのか　\nそれとも褒めてるのか？
entries.en: Are you\ninsulting me,\nor praising me?

entries.jp: 単に僕は　近藤さんに\nありのままの事実を\n知ってもらいたいだけです
entries.en:
I simply want
Kondo-san to
know the
plain truth.

entries.jp: 墓前で格好をつけても\n近藤さんは\n全部お見通しですよ
entries.en:
Putting on airs at
his grave won't
work. Kondo-san
sees right
through all of it.

entries.jp: きっと近藤さんは\n強がる土方さんを見て\n不安に思ってるはずです
entries.en:
I bet Kondo-san
gets anxious
watching you
act tough,
Hijikata-san.

entries.jp: これ以上　近藤さんに\n余計な心配をかけたく\nありません
entries.en:
I don't want to
make Kondo-san
worry any more
than he has to.

entries.jp: 近藤さんに\n心配をかけたくない　か\nそれは俺も同じ気持ちだ
entries.en:
Not wanting to
worry Kondo-san,
huh. I feel the
same way.

entries.jp:
だからこそ近藤の墓前で
格好つけようとしたのだが
と心の中で呟きつつ
土方は苦笑した
entries.en:
"That's exactly
why I tried to
look good at
Kondo's grave,"
Hijikata muttered
to himself with a
wry smile.

entries.jp: 本当に近藤さんには\n色々と世話をかけた
entries.en: We really did\nput Kondo-san\nthrough a lot.

entries.jp: そうですよね
entries.en: We sure did.

entries.jp: 愛獲には派手な雷舞をこなす\n体力が必要だって言って
entries.en:
He'd say idols
need stamina
to pull off
flashy lives...

entries.jp: 自分の少ない給金を叩いて\nいつもご飯をご馳走して\nくれたり
entries.en:
...and he'd dip
into his own
meager pay to
treat us to meals
all the time.

entries.jp: 僕の喉の調子が今一の時は\n雷舞の曲数を減らすように\n幕府の上役に交渉したり
entries.en:
When my throat
wasn't in good
shape, he'd
negotiate with
the shogunate's
higher-ups to
cut down the
songs at the live.

entries.jp: 下らない話にも\n気が済むまで\n付き合ってくれた
entries.en:
He'd put up with
even my silly
chatter for as
long as I liked.

entries.jp: それに土方さんと\n僕の意見が対立すると\nいつも仲裁に入ってくれた
entries.en:
And whenever
you and I clashed,
Hijikata-san, he'd
always step in to
make peace.

entries.jp: ああ　そうだな
entries.en: Yeah, that's right.

entries.jp: 土方さん覚えてます？\n新選組の新曲に歌詞を\n付けた時のこと
entries.en:
Hijikata-san,
remember when
we put lyrics to
the Shinsengumi's
new song?

entries.jp: 俺と総司の作った\n歌詞の　どちらを使うか\n揉めた時のことか
entries.en:
When we fought
over whose
lyrics to use,
mine or yours?

entries.jp: お互い一歩も引かず\n剣まで抜いて一触即発の\n事態になっちゃって
entries.en:
Neither of us
would budge an
inch, and we
even drew
swords. It almost
came to blows.

entries.jp: しかし　近藤さんは\n俺と総司の歌詞から\n言葉を拾い上げて――
entries.en:
But Kondo-san
picked out words
from both your
lyrics and mine--

entries.jp: 新曲に相応しい\n最高の歌詞を作り上げた
entries.en: and made the\nperfect lyrics for\nthe new song.

entries.jp: あの神業には驚いたなぁ\n土方さんと争ってたのが\n馬鹿らしく思えるくらい
entries.en:
That miracle blew
me away. It made
fighting with you
seem so stupid,
Hijikata-san.

entries.jp: あんな事は　海のように\n度量が広い近藤さんにしか\nできませんよ
entries.en:
Only Kondo-san,
with a heart as
big as the ocean,
could pull off
something like
that.

entries.jp: ああ\nそうだな
entries.en: Yeah. That's\nright.

entries.jp: まったく\n近藤さんは凄いことを\nやってのけますよね
entries.en:
Honestly,
Kondo-san sure
pulls off
amazing things.

entries.jp: 土方さんの歌詞は\nセンスのかけらも\nなかったのに
entries.en:
Your lyrics
didn't have a
shred of taste,
Hijikata-san,

entries.jp: 僕の歌詞を基礎（ベース）に\n使えそうな部分を拾って\n合わせるなんて
entries.en:
and still he used
mine as the
base, picked out
the bits he could
use, and blended
them together.

entries.jp: 聞き捨てならんな
entries.en: I can't let\nthat slide.

entries.jp: 基礎になったのは\n俺の歌詞だったろう
entries.en: It was my lyrics\nthat became\nthe base.

entries.jp: はぁ？\n違いますよ　僕です\n僕の歌詞です
entries.en: Huh? No, it\nwasn't. It was\nme. My lyrics.

entries.jp: 俺の歌詞だ\n間違いない
entries.en: They were mine.\nNo doubt about it.

entries.jp: 昔からそうだが\nお前が書く詞は\n地に足がついていない
entries.en:
It's always been
this way: the
lyrics you write
have their head
in the clouds.

entries.jp: そんな歌詞を\n近藤さんが基礎に\nするわけがないだろう
entries.en:
Kondo-san
would never
use lyrics like
that as the base.

entries.jp: なあ\n近藤さん
entries.en: Right,\nKondo-san?

entries.jp: はぁ　これだから\n鈍感の筋肉バカは\nイヤになっちゃうな
entries.en:
Sigh. This is
why insensitive
muscleheads
are such a drag.

entries.jp: おい総司\n貴様
entries.en: Hey, Soji. You...

entries.jp:
二人の間に　険悪な
空気が漂う中
いよいよ　雨足が
強くなり始める
entries.en:
As a hostile air
hung between
the two, the
rain began to
fall harder.

entries.jp: 何かって言うと\nすぐ脱ぎたがるし……
entries.en:
Every chance you
get, you want to
take your clothes
off...

entries.jp: 何が悪い\n誰かのために一肌脱ぐ\nそれが近藤さんの教えだ
entries.en:
What's wrong
with that?
Giving the shirt
off your back for
others--that's
what Kondo-san
taught us.

entries.jp: 脱ぐの意味が\n違いますよ！
entries.en: That's not what\n"shirt off your\nback" means!

entries.jp: 近藤さんを思い出せ\nあの人は常日頃から\n脱ぎまくっていた！
entries.en:
Remember
Kondo-san!
That man was
stripping off
all the time!

entries.jp: 確かに\nそうだけども！
entries.en: Okay, that's\ntrue, but still!

entries.jp: ああ　僕\n新選組に入ったの\n早まったかな……
entries.en: Ugh, maybe I was\ntoo hasty joining\nthe Shinsengumi...

entries.jp: とにかく
entries.en: Anyway.

entries.jp: 土方さんは\n近藤さんの気持ちが\n全然分かっちゃいない
entries.en:
You don't
understand how
Kondo-san felt at
all, Hijikata-san.

entries.jp: それはこっちの台詞だ\nお前はその捻くれた根性を\nそろそろ直した方がいい
entries.en:
That's my line. It's
about time you
fixed that twisted
attitude of yours.

entries.jp: これも良い機会だ\n近藤さんの目の前で\n叩き直してやろう
entries.en:
This is a good
opportunity. I'll
beat it out of you,
right in front of
Kondo-san.

entries.jp: えっ　本当ですか？\nそれは楽しみだなー
entries.en: Oh, really?\nI can't wait~

entries.jp: 近藤さん\n聞きました？
entries.en: Kondo-san, did\nyou hear that?

entries.jp: 土方さんが　僕に\n局長の肩書きを\n譲ってくれるそうです
entries.en:
Hijikata-san
says he's going
to hand the title
of Commander
over to me.

entries.jp: 言ったな？\n軽口では済まさんぞ\n総司……
entries.en:
You said it,
didn't you?
This won't end
as a joke, Soji...

entries.jp: 土砂降りの雨に打たれつつ\n土方と沖田は刀の鯉口に\n手をかける
entries.en:
Beaten by the
pouring rain,
Hijikata and Okita
set their hands on
their swords,
ready to draw.

entries.jp: まさに一触即発の状況だった
entries.en: One spark, and it\nwould all explode.

entries.jp: 雨でぬかるんだ地面を\n踏みしめ　互いの間合いを\n詰める土方と沖田
entries.en:
Planting their
feet on the
rain-soaked
ground, Hijikata
and Okita closed
the distance
between them.

entries.jp: 二人は近藤の墓前で刀を交え\n殺気のこもった視線で相手を\n睨みつける……
entries.en:
Crossing
blades before
Kondo's grave,
the two glared
at each other
with murder
in their eyes...

entries.jp: その時――
entries.en: Just then--

entries.jp: 突如として稲妻が走り\n巨大な岩に雷が落ちた
entries.en:
A sudden bolt of
lightning flashed,
and struck a huge
boulder.

entries.jp:
落雷の衝撃で　岩は
真っ二つに割れ　それぞれ
土方と沖田の方へと
倒れ落ちてきた
entries.en:
The impact split
the boulder
clean in two, and
the halves came
toppling down
toward Hijikata
and Okita.

entries.jp: ぬおおおおおっ
entries.en: Raaaaaagh!

entries.jp: やああぁぁぁっ
entries.en: Haaaaaah!

entries.jp: 二人が同時に\n刀を抜き払う！
entries.en: The two drew\ntheir swords at\nthe same moment!

entries.jp: 二つに割れた岩は\nガラガラと音を立てて\n砕け散った
entries.en:
The split boulder
shattered to
pieces with a
rumbling crash.

entries.jp:
突然襲った窮地を
脱した事を確認した二人は
お互いの顔から視線を
逸らさぬまま　どちらから
ともなく歩み寄る
entries.en:
Seeing they had
escaped the
sudden danger,
the two stepped
toward each
other, never
taking their eyes
off one another.

entries.jp: 総司\nお前……
entries.en: Soji. You...

entries.jp: なぜ　俺の方に\n倒れてきた岩を\n斬った
entries.en: Why did you cut\nthe rock that was\nfalling on me?

entries.jp: まずは\n自分の身を守れ！
entries.en: Protect\nyourself first!

entries.jp: その台詞　\nそっくりそのまま\n土方さんに返します
entries.en: I'll give that exact\nline right back to\nyou, Hijikata-san.

entries.jp: 土方さんこそ\n僕の方に倒れてきた\n岩を斬ったでしょう
entries.en:
You cut the rock
that was falling
on me, didn't you,
Hijikata-san?

entries.jp: そ　それは……\n咄嗟に体が動いたんだ
entries.en: Th-that was... My\nbody just moved\non its own.

entries.jp: ……僕も同じですよ\n頭で考える前に\n勝手に体が動いたんです
entries.en:
...Same here. My
body moved on
its own before I
could even think.

entries.jp:
巨大な岩が二人に
襲い掛かってきた時
土方は沖田の目前の岩に
沖田は土方の目前の岩に
咄嗟に斬りかかっていた
entries.en:
As the rocks fell,
Hijikata had
slashed at the
one before
Okita, and Okita
at the one before
Hijikata, without
a thought.

entries.jp: ……今の雷はきっと\n近藤さんだな
entries.en: ...That lightning\nmust have been\nKondo-san.

entries.jp: 仲違いを\nしていた俺達を\nいさめてくれたんだ
entries.en: He was scolding\nus for quarreling.

entries.jp: ……ですかね
entries.en: ...Maybe so.

entries.jp: 二人ともいい加減にしろ\nって　近藤さんの声が\n聞こえた気がします
entries.en:
I feel like I heard
Kondo-san's voice
saying, "Knock it
off, you two."

entries.jp: ああ……
entries.en: Yeah...

entries.jp:
二人は会話を交わしながら
改めて近藤の墓前を見つめる
その口元には
笑みが浮かんでいた
entries.en:
Still talking,
the two looked
once more at
Kondo's grave.
Smiles played
on their lips.

entries.jp: 近藤さん　すまなかった\nこんなつまらない争いは\nもうしない
entries.en:
Kondo-san, I'm
sorry. No more
petty fights
like this.

entries.jp: 近藤さん　ごめんなさい\n土方さんとは出来るだけ\n仲良くやっていきます
entries.en:
Sorry,
Kondo-san. I'll
try to get along
with Hijikata-san
as best I can.

entries.jp:
近藤の墓前に
誓いを立てると
土方と沖田は
刀を鞘に収めた
entries.en:
Having made
their vow before
Kondo's grave,
Hijikata and
Okita sheathed
their swords.

entries.jp: すると先程までの雨がやみ\n再び夕日が顔を出した
entries.en:
Then the rain
stopped, and
the evening
sun showed
its face again.

entries.jp: まるで自分たちの仲直りを\n近藤が喜んでいるようだと\n二人は思った――
entries.en:
To the two of
them, it seemed
as if Kondo
were rejoicing
that they had
made up--

entries.jp: そろそろ\n屯所に戻るか
entries.en: Shall we\nhead back to\nheadquarters?

entries.jp: はい
entries.en: Sure.

entries.jp: 近藤の墓前に一礼して\n二人はゆっくり歩きだす
entries.en:
Bowing once
before Kondo's
grave, the two
slowly set off.

entries.jp: それにしても土方さん
entries.en: By the way,\nHijikata-san...

entries.jp: 岩に雷が落ちた時\n腰が抜けそうなほど\n驚いてましたね
entries.en:
When the
lightning hit
that rock, you
jumped so hard
you nearly fell
on your butt.

entries.jp: 当たり前だろう\nあんな近くに落雷したんだ\n誰だって驚く
entries.en:
Of course I did.
Lightning struck
that close. Anyone
would jump.

entries.jp: 鬼の土方も　雷の前では\n泣いて逃げるしかない\nって訳ですね
entries.en:
So even Hijikata
the demon can
only cry and run
when thunder
strikes, huh?

entries.jp: この話　スカシくんや\nトサカくんが聞いたら\n喜びそうだなー
entries.en:
Mr. Poser and
Tosaka-kun
would just love to
hear this story~

entries.jp: おい　坂本はともかく\n高杉に話すのはよせ\nあとで面倒なことに――
entries.en:
Hey, Sakamoto
is one thing, but
don't tell
Takasugi. It'll be
a pain later on--

entries.jp: さっそく\n話さなくちゃ！
entries.en: Gotta go tell\nthem right away!

entries.jp: あっ　おい\nくそっ　あいつ
entries.en: Ah, hey! Dammit,\nthat guy...

entries.jp: 止まれ総司！\n止まらなければ\n斬って捨てる
entries.en: Stop, Soji! Stop or\nI'll cut you down!

entries.jp:
いつしか空は晴れ渡り
傾きかけた夕日を受けて
近藤の墓から落ちる滴が
きらりと光る
entries.en:
Before anyone
noticed, the sky
had cleared, and
the drops falling
from Kondo's
grave glinted in
the setting sun.

entries.jp: 近藤勇の魂が\n安らかに眠りにつける日は\n当分　訪れなさそうだ
entries.en:
It seemed the day
Isami Kondo's
soul could rest in
peace would not
come for quite a
while yet.
